_about: Everything that belongs to ONE person's Reel setup lives here; lib/ holds no names, paths or ids. Paths are relative to automation/reel-hf unless absolute. The 'set up my Reel engine' skill (.claude/skills/reel-engine-setup) writes this file, lib/doctor.mjs checks it and fixes what it can. These values are Mercedes's (Scrolly).

owner.name: Mercedes
owner._note: name shows in status lines ('waiting on <name>'); instagram is the handle on the review page's post preview

_brand: default brand kit id from lib/brand/index.mjs (the review page's Brand kit dropdown can still switch per Reel)

folders._note: footage = raw takes, one subfolder per series. exports = final/<slug>.mp4, <slug>/cover.png, previews/. A synced folder (OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud) gets the finished Reels onto the phone; keep it 'always on this device'.

tools._note: browser = Edge or Chrome for headless stills and covers (empty = auto-detect). hyperframesDir holds puppeteer; bin holds ffmpeg + ffprobe (put on PATH for HyperFrames). python = the venv with faster-whisper.

review._note: shared false = the local review page (fast, private). true = a hosted page others can open (not built yet).

posting._note: videoHost: 'wordpress' uploads the posting copy to WordPress media through wordpressClient (exports wp() and BASE; credentials stay in that client's .env), or 'none' to stop at the posting copy file. scheduler names the queue on the review page; empty = no queue option.

tracker.name: Content Planner
tracker._note: Where Reel ideas and posts are tracked. app 'planner' = Mercedes's Content Planner (automation/planner, switched from the Notion Content Pipeline 2026-10-27), read and changed with the cli; 'none' = start Reels from chat only. statuses = the Instagram lane's stage: edit = waiting to be drafted, hold = approved but not queued, scheduled = in the Buffer queue. A card's reelFolder says it's drafted; rows = the old Notion row id → Reel folder ledger, history only.

list: Statements: condensed heavy grotesque; emphasis = marker swipe (<m>word</m>); asides handwritten. Never italic serif accents or color-changed words. No eyebrow cards.
Graphics around the body (above the head first), never over the face. Circles and scribbles never cross the text they mark.

One music track, one level (Quiet / Normal / Up front, measured against the voice) + fades. Never the SAME sound effect back to back, except list items: each item of a spoken list can share one sound.
No em dashes or '|' on screen. No fake proof.
Business Brain CTA = name + scrollyseo.com, never the price. IG bio link = $1K Challenge.
rules._note: list = the short version baked into every build plan; doc + section = the full, growing rule list (new 'love this / never do that' rules go there).

cta._note: Endings the Plan step offers. Comment a word only (Mercedes 2026-10-27: every post asks for a comment word that Chat Manager answers with a DM; use the planner card's keyword, live in Chat Manager). Delete offer to show all.

templates._note: per-person overrides of lib/templates/*.mjs (deep-merged). Studio music: measured level Normal (about 21 dB under her voice), slow fade-in.
